confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Hotel and hostel rates vary widely by district (Malate, Ermita, Makati, Bonifacio Global City) and by season, so they are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are not directly known and are set from the local beer-to-bar price relationship. FX: 0.6955 is the RBA figure for 2026-10-15 as reported in search results; I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, so verify it there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Southeast Asian big-city pricing. Manila is set somewhat below Bangkok for food and drink and roughly in line with it for mid-range hotels.
